lessons.title: Üçüncü tip koşul — olmamış olanı konuşmak
lessons.canDo: Geçmişte olmamış bir şeyin sonuçlarını tartışabilir, pişmanlık ve eleştiri belirtebilirim.

concept.summary: Geçmişte gerçekleşmemiş bir koşulun, gerçekleşmemiş sonucunu anlatır. Yapı iki kat geriye gider: koşul past perfect, sonuç would have + V3. Türkçedeki "-seydi … -ecekti" kalıbının tam karşılığıdır ve gerçeğin tersini söylediğini baştan belli eder.

table.example: If I had known, I would have called.
If they hadn't helped, we would still be there.

examples.en: If I had known, I would have told you.
examples.tr: Bilseydim sana söylerdim.

examples.en: We would have missed the flight if the traffic had been worse.
examples.tr: Trafik daha kötü olsaydı uçuşu kaçırırdık.

examples.en: She could have finished it in time with more help.
examples.tr: Daha çok yardım olsa zamanında bitirebilirdi.

examples.en: If they hadn't helped us, we would still be there.
examples.tr: Onlar yardım etmeseydi hâlâ orada olurduk.
examples.note: Koşul geçmiş, sonuç şimdi: karma tip.

examples.en: He would never have applied if you hadn't pushed him.
examples.tr: Sen zorlamasaydın asla başvurmazdı.

mistakes.wrong: If I would have known, I would have told you.
mistakes.right: If I had known, I would have told you.

mistakes.wrong: If I had known, I would told you.
mistakes.right: If I had known, I would have told you.

mistakes.wrong: If she had asked, I helped her.
mistakes.right: If she had asked, I would have helped her.
mistakes.why: Gerçekleşmemiş sonuç düz geçmiş zamanla anlatılmaz.

exercises.text: If she ___ earlier, she would have caught the train.
We ___ if we had had more time.
He ___ the job if he had applied.
If you ___ me, I would have helped.
If the report ___ on time, nobody would have complained.
They ___ the house if the price had been lower.
If we had taken the other road, we ___ there by now.
exercises.note: Karma tip: geçmiş koşul, bugünkü sonuç.

exercises.text: She ___ have said that if she had known you were listening.
exercises.note: never, would ile have arasına girer.

exercises.text: If I ___ him, I would have recognized his voice.
The team ___ if the referee had seen the foul.

lessons.title: by the time — hangi iş önce bitmişti
lessons.canDo: İki olayın hangisinin önce tamamlandığını tek cümlede kesin biçimde anlatabilirim.

concept.summary: by the time "-e kadar, -diğinde" demektir ve her zaman iki olay arasında sıra kurar: cümleciğin anlattığı an geldiğinde, esas cümlenin işi çoktan bitmiştir. Geçmişte esas cümle past perfect, gelecekte will have + V3 olur. Cümleciğin kendisi asla gelecek zaman almaz.

table.example: By the time we arrived, it had closed.
By the time you read this, I will have left.
By the time he comes, not: will come.
By Friday the work will have finished.

examples.en: By the time the police arrived, the thieves had gone.
examples.tr: Polis geldiğinde hırsızlar gitmişti.

examples.en: By the time she finished school, her family had moved three times.
examples.tr: O okulu bitirene kadar ailesi üç kez taşınmıştı.
examples.note: Uzun bir süre boyunca olan iş.

examples.en: By the time you read this, I will have left the country.
examples.tr: Sen bunu okuduğunda ben ülkeden ayrılmış olacağım.

examples.en: By the time we noticed the mistake, the letters had been sent.
examples.tr: Hatayı fark ettiğimizde mektuplar gönderilmişti.

examples.en: By the time the meeting ends, the shops will have closed.
examples.tr: Toplantı bittiğinde dükkânlar kapanmış olacak.
examples.note: Cümlecikte geniş zaman, esas cümlede gelecek.

mistakes.wrong: By the time we arrived, the shop closed.
mistakes.right: By the time we arrived, the shop had closed.
mistakes.why: Önce olan iş past perfect ister.

mistakes.wrong: By the time he will come, we will have finished.
mistakes.right: By the time he comes, we will have finished.

mistakes.wrong: By the time I will be forty, I will have paid the loan.
mistakes.right: By the time I am forty, I will have paid the loan.

exercises.text: By the time I got home, everyone ___ .
By the time the train ___ , we had been waiting an hour.
By the time you ___ this letter, I will be in Ankara.
By the time the doctor came, the pain ___ .
By next summer they ___ here for ten years.
By the time we found the hotel, it ___ dark.
By the time the results ___ , most students had gone home.
By the time she is thirty, she ___ two degrees.
By the time the fire brigade arrived, the roof ___ .
By the time we get to the theatre, the play ___ .

lessons.title: If you should — ihtimali uzak koşul
lessons.canDo: Bir ihtimali uzak görerek, resmî bir tonda koşul kurabilirim.

concept.summary: if + should, koşulun gerçekleşme ihtimalini düşürür: "bir ihtimal olursa". should burada gereklilik bildirmez, olasılığı zayıflatır. Resmî yazışmada ve talimatlarda geçer; günlük konuşmada yerini düz if + geniş zaman alır.

table.example: If you should see him, tell him to call.
If it should rain, take the car.
If anything should change, we will write.

examples.en: If it should rain tomorrow, we will cancel the trip.
examples.tr: Yarın yağmur yağacak olursa geziyi iptal ederiz.

examples.en: If you should need anything, the office is open until six.
examples.tr: Bir şeye ihtiyacınız olursa ofis altıya kadar açık.

examples.en: If the machine should stop, press the red button.
examples.tr: Makine duracak olursa kırmızı düğmeye basın.

examples.en: If anyone should ask, say nothing about the price.
examples.tr: Biri soracak olursa fiyat hakkında bir şey söyleme.

examples.en: If the results should be delayed, candidates will be informed.
examples.tr: Sonuçlar gecikecek olursa adaylara bilgi verilecek.

mistakes.wrong: If it should rains tomorrow, we will cancel.
mistakes.right: If it should rain tomorrow, we will cancel.

mistakes.wrong: If you should to need help, call me.
mistakes.right: If you should need help, call me.
mistakes.why: should ile fiil arasına to girmez.

mistakes.wrong: If it should rain, we would cancel.
mistakes.right: If it should rain, we will cancel.
mistakes.why: Bu yapı gerçek ihtimali anlatır, sonucu would ile kurulmaz.

exercises.text: If you ___ change your mind, the offer stays open.
If the alarm should ___ , leave by the nearest exit.
If anything should ___ wrong, we will contact you at once.
If you should ___ any errors, please write to the editor.
If the payment should be late, the bank ___ you.
If she should ___ before us, ask her to wait.
___ the weather should turn, the match will be moved.
If anyone should ___ for me, I am in the back office.
If the file should ___ , we keep a second copy on paper.
If you should be ___ in the position, send us your papers.

lessons.title: Should you need — if'siz devrik koşul
lessons.canDo: Resmî yazışmada koşulu if kullanmadan kurabilirim.

concept.summary: Resmî dilde koşul, if atılıp should öne alınarak kurulur: Should you need help, call us. Anlam if + should ile aynıdır; fark tondadır. Devrik biçim yazılı ve resmî metne özgüdür, günlük konuşmada kullanılmaz. if ile devrik biçim bir arada bulunmaz.

table.example: If you should need help, call us.
Should you need help, call us.
Should you not wish to attend, let us know.
not: Should you need help, if call us.

examples.en: Should you require further information, please contact us.
examples.tr: Daha fazla bilgiye ihtiyaç duyarsanız lütfen bizimle iletişime geçin.

examples.en: Should the weather change, the event will move indoors.
examples.tr: Hava değişirse etkinlik içeriye alınacak.

examples.en: Should anything go wrong, call this number.
examples.tr: Bir aksilik olursa bu numarayı arayın.

examples.en: Should you decide to accept, sign both copies.
examples.tr: Kabul etmeye karar verirseniz iki nüshayı da imzalayın.

examples.en: Should you not receive the parcel by Friday, let us know.
examples.tr: Paketi cumaya kadar almazsanız bize bildirin.

mistakes.wrong: Should you need help, if call me.
mistakes.right: Should you need help, call me.
mistakes.why: Devrik biçim if'in yerini alır, ikisi bir arada olmaz.

mistakes.wrong: Should you to need help, call me.
mistakes.right: Should you need help, call me.

mistakes.wrong: Should it rains tomorrow, we will cancel.
mistakes.right: Should it rain tomorrow, we will cancel.

exercises.text: ___ you need assistance, our staff will be happy to help.
Should the flight ___ delayed, passengers will be contacted.
Should you ___ to cancel, there is no charge.
Should anything ___ , I will call you at once.
Should you ___ wish to take part, simply ignore this letter.
Should you ___ her before Friday, give her my number.
___ the goods arrive damaged, we will replace them free of charge.
Should the system ___ down, use the paper forms.
Should there ___ any questions, we will answer them at the end.
Should you ___ any difficulty, our office will assist you.
